label: Progress Bar
description: One number shown as a shape that fills: a labelled progress bar (default), a hairline RING gauge that draws round while the number counts up ('98% deliverability'), or a STAR rating whose gold fill sweeps to a fractional score ('4.8 on G2'). Pick the shape with style.

value.label: Current value (a percent of max for bar/ring; the rating for stars, e.g. 4.8)

label.label: Label (above the bar; under the ring or stars, e.g. 'on G2 · 1,200 reviews')

style.label: 'bar' (default) | 'ring' (arc gauge, value counts up in the centre) | 'stars' (rating out of max, default 5)

sublabel.label: ring: a small line under the number inside the ring
